name: food-signal
description: Food Signal MVP - AI-powered dining safety assistant (PWA + Azure Functions).

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace shared --if-present && npm run test --workspace api --if-present && npm run test --workspace frontend --if-present
scripts.dev: echo "Run 'npm run dev --workspace frontend' and 'npm run start --workspace api' in separate terminals, or use 'swa start'."
scripts.start:swa: swa start http://localhost:5173 --run "npm run dev --workspace frontend" --api-location ./api
